_readme: Manual decisions. Each entry has a value plus a note/source. The fetch script applies these AFTER downloading, so they survive data refreshes.

TR.note: Rule given by the project owner.

RU.note: Rule given by the project owner.

EG.note: Rule given by the project owner.

CY.note: EU member; most common convention (geographically in Asia).

GE.note: UN geoscheme: Western Asia. Caucasus is a convention call.

KZ.note: Most of the territory lies in Asia (small part west of the Ural river).

GL.note: Geographically part of the North American continent.

TR.note: Dataset uses 'Türkiye'; 'Turkey' is the common English name.

CG.note: Disambiguation from DR Congo; dataset says just 'Congo'.

BO.note: Sucre = constitutional capital, La Paz = seat of government. Wikipedia article on the country, infobox 'Capital' / 'Seat of government'

SZ.note: Mbabane = administrative, Lobamba = legislative/royal capital. Wikipedia article on the country, infobox 'Capital' / 'Seat of government'

PS.note: Ramallah = seat of government, East Jerusalem = declared capital. Wikipedia article on the country, infobox 'Capital' / 'Seat of government'

LK.note: Kotte = legislative capital, Colombo = executive/judicial capital. Wikipedia article on the country, infobox 'Capital' / 'Seat of government'

currencies.source: Micronesia uses the US dollar (Wikipedia: Federated States of Micronesia, 'Currency'); missing in dataset.

languages.source: Dataset lists only the dialect 'Austro-Bavarian German'; German is the official language (Austrian Federal Constitution, Art. 8).

government.source: Wikipedia: Cyprus, infobox 'Government' (infobox field empty in parsed section; Wikidata gave a vague label).

_capitalAliases_note: Extra ACCEPTED answers (not shown as the main capital). Alternate spellings, former/de-facto seats. Source: Wikipedia article of the country/city (alternative names), common English variants.
_nameAliases_note: Extra ACCEPTED country names for the map quiz, on top of the dataset's official name and alternative spellings.
